maya: Miniwave launch Tue 10am PT. Need X + LinkedIn schedule, assets, and 48h engagement owners. cc @lena @tom

lena: I can own X posting + replies first 24h. Need hero 1200x675 + square for clip.

tom: I'll own LI threads and partner outreach. Is the benchmark blurb final?

maya: Draft here: drive/xxx. Bullets: predictable latency; dedicated vs hosted; Acme case blurb. Shorten for LI pls.

cj: Assets needed: hero JPG, square PNG, 30s mp4, 15s vertical, CTA overlay, alt text.

katie: Webinar link?

social-bot: https://redwood.ai/events/miniwave?utm_source=social

lena: X thread plan: teaser -> stat -> CTA. Post at 10:00am PT, 3:00pm PT, next day 9:00am PT. Pin FAQ reply with timezone conversions.

tom: LI draft: "Shipping inference that scales — predictable latency, cost controls, and unified deploys. Join our webinar for benchmarks + live Q&A. Register -> https://redwood.ai/events/miniwave?utm_campaign=miniwave_launch&utm_source=linkedin"

lena: Add stat: "2–5x cost reduction in kv-caching workloads" — legal ok?

katie: Legal cleared the stat, backup variant without stat ready.

maya: CJ render clip with overlay stat + CTA by Fri EOD. Also 15s vertical.

cj: Will submit to #marketing-assets and Drive.

maya: Owners for first responses: lena (X support-type replies), katie (product Qs on LI), tom (partner mentions). We'll collect top 10 replies, route demo leads to AE, DM top prospects.

lena: Also schedule RSVP reminder DM 24h before.

social-bot: Reminder: submit final assets to #marketing-assets by 2026-04-04T23:59Z

maya: Final checklist: assets, captions (X/LI), UTMs, schedule, owners, playbook. Anything missing?

tom: I'll post revised LI copy in doc for signoff.

lena: :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team! :rocket:
